# async_poll_stateless — async_job with cursor_update.kind=stateless
# Same submit → poll → fetch chain as async_poll_latest_ts but the
# cursor_update is stateless: no last_timestamp is written on completion.
# Only the framework-internal phase pointer (reset to "submit" after
# on_complete) remains in the persisted cursor.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml async_poll_stateless
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --state state.json --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl
chomp want_state.json
cmp state.json want_state.json

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"POST","phase":"submit","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 27 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":202,"step_id":"submit","url":"$URL_HOST/async_poll_stateless/exports"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"GET","phase":"poll","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 100 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"poll","url":"$URL_HOST/async_poll_stateless/exports/exp-000001/status"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":3,"method":"GET","phase":"fetch","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 347 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"fetch","url":"$URL_HOST/async_poll_stateless/results/exp-000001"}
